Bring MEA Output onto the Shared Enrichment Column Names

Source: R/compute_enrichment.R
canonicalize_mea_columns.Rd

The kinase-library tool writes `Kinase`, `p-value` and a `Subs fraction` field of the form `85/471`. The enrichment reports expect `kinase`, `pvalue`, and the fraction split into its leading-edge count and set size.

Usage

canonicalize_mea_columns(mea_results)

Arguments

mea_results

Concatenated MEA results.

Value

The same table, renamed and with the fraction split.
